messages:
mike: Heads-up — cutover tonight 03:00 UTC. Plan: pin runtime v2.4.1, api v1.8.0. Console change is just a feature flag flip. Need a quick router compatibility check before we pin. @sarah @jj can you confirm router header-split + runtime kernel change won’t break KV handshake? deploy-bot says dry-run queued.

deploy-bot: dry-run queued in 45m. Will auto-freeze pins 15m before window. /deploy status: no pending DB migrations.

sarah: I ran header-split smoke on staging earlier. Router returns 200s overall but we saw spikes of 502s when the runtime kernel path switched (quantized models). Suspect ABI ordering change for token headers. Logs: ```
ERROR 2026-03-23T01:12:03Z router: upstream 502 runtime kernel mismatch: expected header-order v1, got v2
stack: router.handler -> runtime.request -> runtime.kv
```

jj: Router side: header-split flag is backward-compatible for API v1.8, but runtime v2.4.1 does change header ordering when new batching kicks in. I can add a short-lived compatibility shim in the router that tolerates both orders. Will canary it.

mike: OK. Rollback plan: if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, rollback runtime to v2.4.0 first. If router errors persist after runtime rollback, enable shim flag then consider router rollback. @oncall-sre you good with SLO thresholds?

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'll own monitoring and set a chatops alert rule: errors >0.5% for 5m -> auto-notify #incidents and ping PD. Please add an explicit `router-shim=true` note to release notes so console/SEs see it.

console-eng: We'll add a UI warning toggle during rollout and patch release notes with the shim flag. Also adding a telemetry probe that verifies header ordering from the console path.

jj: Pushing canary to two router nodes now (2/2). Will watch p95 and error rate; will update here in ~5m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete, canary started (2/2). No migrations. Estimated full rollout 20m after verification.

sarah: Seeing a modest latency bump (~30ms) on KV hot paths in canary, but error rate stable so far. If latency >200ms p95 for 3m, mark for rollback.

mike: Sounds good. Locking pin window 03:00–03:30 UTC (no other pins inside). I'll draft release note: "runtime v2.4.1 — kernel batching improvements; api v1.8.0 — forward-compatible header parsing; router — optional compatibility shim (auto-expire 1h)."

jj: Note: shim auto-expires in 1h post-rollout. I'll tag rollout metadata with `#shim-flag` and add a console probe check.

sarah: LGTM :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: Pager rotation on standby. I'll escalate if thresholds hit.
